f3_program: collection("party.attendees.women", "woman", "party", source("60 women at the party"))
observe(at("party.attendees.women.count", "current"), 60, "count", source("60 women at the party"))
fraction_of(at("party.attendees.women.married.count", "current"), at("party.attendees.women.count", "current"), 3, 4, source("three-fourths of these women were married"))

add("bring_husbands", "party.attendees.women.married", at("party.attendees.men.count", "current"), "party.attendees.men.husbands_brought.count", source("brought their husbands with them to the party"))
fraction_of(at("party.attendees.men.single.count", "current"), at("party.attendees.men.count", "current"), 3, 4, source("3/4 of the men at the party were single"))
assumptions: The party attendance state is represented as current.
No one-to-one husband count or exhaustive marital-status partition is assumed; the husband-event quantity remains symbolic.

f3_program: partition("oil.cans", at("oil.total_volume", "current"), source("290 liters of oil in 24 cans"))
assumptions: The cans' physical location is not stated, so their collection location is represented as unspecified.
The per-can target is preserved without asserting a calculated remainder or division result.

f3_program: observe(at("group.net_change_in_cash_balance", "2019"), -16, "S$ million", cell("Net change in cash balance", "2019"))
observe(at("group.net_change_in_cash_balance", "2018"), -5, "S$ million", cell("Net change in cash balance", "2018"))
assumptions: Parenthesized table amounts are interpreted as negative values, and the table's S$ million unit applies to both values.

f3_program: younger_than(at("freddy.age", "now"), at("stephanie.age", "now"), 2, "year", source("Freddy is 2 years younger than Stephanie"))
multiple(at("stephanie.age", "now"), at("job.age", "now"), 4, source("Stephanie is 4 times as old as Job"))
collection("parking_lot.sections", "section", "parking_lot", source("parking lot is divided into 3 sections"))
partition("parking_lot.sections", at("parking_lot.spaces.count", "current"), source("A 1000 car parking lot is divided into 3 sections"))
offset(at("parking_lot.section_2.spaces.count", "current"), at("parking_lot.section_3.spaces.count", "current"), 200, "count", source("200 more in section 2 than in section 3"))
assumptions: The phrase "1000 car parking lot" is interpreted as a parking lot with 1,000 spaces, consistent with the later references to spaces.
